priority: Reference-extraction study first. Reading skill absent in all primary arms; do not merge skills.
data: Modern Russian HWR200; each writer has a separate complete source FPR document and held-out original document; target text families are distinct.

conditions.B: Same-writer packet extracted from source scans only
conditions.C: Same-writer packet extracted from identical source scans plus their published full source transcription

extractor: Independent fresh Astra context per writer and source condition; frozen snapshot, never target scans or answers. Extract each packet once; reader repetitions reuse that exact packet.
references: Survey ALL source pages first; up to24 visually checked native-pixel crops per arm with original exclusive xyxy/hash metadata. All labels provisional or dataset-assisted-provisional. No fabricated crops. Provide same labelled JPEG contact sheet max1600x2400 and at most1MiB to every model plus selected-label JSON. Native crops retained for audit, not extra per-reader inputs.
input_control: Identical original target bytes in every condition; no parent resizing/cropping of targets. Same frozen prompt and inspection limits within each model. Fresh blind reader context per writer/condition/repetition; no evaluator text, previous errors or other predictions. One initial image presentation per target plus at most2 additional original-image requests for tool-using hosts; record actual coverage and thumbnail failures. DeepSeek receives originals once in independent API requests, original detail, non-thinking, temperature0; host differences explicit.
audit: Before recognition, inspect target scans against supplied full text, and inspect source/target handwriting consistency. Save flags and literal proposed corrections in evaluator-only audit files. Primary labels remain published; an explicitly assistant-audited secondary label set may be frozen before inference, never called human-verified. Do not silently normalize copy errors or repetitions. Human-review uncertainties remain flagged.
eligibility: Replace a group only before recognition for a wrong/missing target document, insufficient full-text correspondence, or writer-attribution conflict; never for recognition score or difficult handwriting. Log any replacement and use listed reserve writers.
metric: Whole target document joined in numeric page order, per writer. Primary readingCER NFC/casefold/Unicode punctuation removal/whitespace collapse, ё retained. LiteralCER secondary. Average repetitions within writer; report mean per-writerCER, wins/ties/losses out of actual paired writers, pooledCER, paired writer-bootstrap uncertainty and failures. Do not treat pages or repeated runs as independent writers.
baseline: Freeze and run the strongest available local conventional baseline (Russian CRNN from existing matched selection) on all45targets, using original bytes and same goldscope. Record exact weights/versions/preprocessing. Transkribus full45would exceed available authorized freecredits: do not buy credits or pretend complete coverage. Rehand can be probed once; record service failure and do not fabricate scores.

api_budget.authorization: Pre-existing bounded approval; no additional funds or paid retries. Private shared ledger and approval balance are omitted.
api_budget.policy: Use existing locked reserve/settle helper. Unknown billing stays reserved. No automatic paid retries. Complete first replicate across writers before second; hard-stop new API calls at cap. No new paid services or Grok calls. Credentials never printed, stored in reports or passed to child readers.

promotion: Do not modify published core skills or tune prompts on these targets. This is confirmation of frozen extraction workflows, not permission to claim universal accuracy gains. Publish actual outcomes and limitations.
publication_note: Public copy preserves experiment parameters and frozen skill hashes; only private ledger location, shared approval balance and remaining account credit balance are omitted. Exact execution protocol retained in the producing workspace.
